title: JUJUTSU KAISEN [Hindi]
description:
A boy fights... for "the right death."

Hardship, regret, shame: the negative feelings that humans feel become Curses that lurk in our everyday lives. The Curses run rampant throughout the world, capable of leading people to terrible misfortune and even death. What's more, the Curses can only be exorcised by another Curse.

Itadori Yuji is a boy with tremendous physical strength, though he lives a completely ordinary high school life. One day, to save a friend who has been attacked by Curses, he eats the finger of the Double-Faced Specter, taking the Curse into his own soul. From then on, he shares one body with the Double-Faced Specter. Guided by the most powerful of sorcerers, Gojou Satoru, Itadori is admitted to the Tokyo Metropolitan Technical High School of Sorcery, an organization that fights the Curses... and thus begins the heroic tale of a boy who became a Curse to exorcise a Curse, a life from which he could never turn back.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Note: The first episode received an early web premiere on September 19th, 2020. The regular TV broadcast started on October 3rd, 2020.

🧡 ■ "eFootball™" - An Evolution from "PES"
It's an all-new era of digital soccer: "PES" has now evolved into "eFootball™"! And now you can experience the next generation of soccer gaming with "eFootball™"!

■ Welcoming Newcomers
After downloading, you can learn the basic controls of the game via a step-by-step tutorial that includes practical demonstrations! Complete them all, and receive Lionel Messi!

[Ways of Playing]
■ Build Your Very Own Dream Team
You have a plethora of teams that can be chosen as your Base Team, including European and South American powerhouses, J.League and national teams!

■ Sign Players
After creating your team, it's time to get some signings in! From current superstars to soccer legends, sign players and take your team to new heights!

・ Special Player List
Here you can sign special players such as standouts from actual fixtures, players from featured leagues, and legends of the game!

・ Standard Player List
Here you can handpick and sign your favorite players. You can also use the Sort and Filter functions to narrow your search.

■ Playing Matches
Once you have built a team with your favorite players, it's time to take them to the field.
From testing your skills against the AI, to competing for ranking in Online Matches, enjoy eFootball™ the way you like!

・ Sharpen your skills in VS AI Matches
There are a variety of Events that coincide with the real-world soccer calendar, including a "Starter" Event for those just starting out, as well as Events where you can play against teams from high-profile leagues. Build a Dream Team that fits the Events' themes and take part!

・ Put your strength to the test in User Matches
Enjoy real-time competition with the Division-based "eFootball™ League" and a wide variety of weekly Events. Can you take your Dream Team to the pinnacle of Division 1?

・ Max 3 vs 3 matches with friends
Use the Friend Match feature to play against your friends. Show them the true colors of your well-developed team!
Cooperative matches up to 3 vs 3 are also available. Get together with your friends and enjoy some heated soccer action!

■ Player Development
Depending on Player Types, signed players can be further developed.
Level up your players by having them play in matches and by using in-game items, then utilize the acquired Progression Points to develop them to match your playing style.

[For More Fun]
■ Weekly Live Updates
Data from real matches being played around the world is collated on a weekly basis and implemented in-game through the Live Update feature to create a more authentic experience. These updates affect various aspects of the game, including player Condition Ratings and team rosters.

title: A Herdeira vs. A Falsa
description: Ela e o namorado estavam em um relacionamento à distância há quatro anos. Após o ensino médio, ela foi estudar no exterior e, para que ele não se sentisse inseguro com sua origem modesta, manteve em segredo o status de sua família rica, fingindo vir de uma família comum e alegando que estava estudando fora com empréstimos estudantis. Durante os quatro anos separados, ela sempre acreditou no amor dele por ela. No entanto, em uma reunião de volta para casa, ela o viu de braços dados com a filha adotiva de sua família, e naquele momento, suas ilusões se desmancharam. A filha adotiva estava usando o nome da família em benefício próprio, posando como a verdadeira herdeira. Na reunião, ela e um grupo de colegas a zombaram e humilharam, mas a verdadeira herdeira não estava mais se escondendo—ela chamou os três irmãos, que rapidamente colocaram todos em seus lugares.

title: Laila B.
description: Since surviving a physical assault on the steps of her South Boston apartment, Laila Bataglia (30) has been keeping a low profile. She spends her days hiding behind her social media persona and struggles to make ends meet as a freelance writer and part-time bartender at The Clock Tower, where she works with her ever-supportive best friend, Patrice. When a young woman turns up dead in her neighborhood, Laila is forced to face her fears again, revealing that her real fight is far from over. title: R&B Divas
description: Each has had their ups and each have had their downs -- all in the harsh light of stardom. Faith Evans, Nicci Gilbert, Monifah Carter, Syleena Johnson and KeKe Wyatt -- five strong women who have been broken down and are rebuilding from the ground up. R&B Divas takes you inside the lives of these music stars as they work, play and struggle to get their lives and careers back on track. Brought together by their friendship and love of R&B goddess Whitney Houston, these incredible singers are dealing with everything from divorce to drugs and sexuality.

title: Reunion: The Sound of the Providence S1-S2
description: A decade has passed since the tomb-raiders Wu Xie, Wang Pang Zi, and Zhang Qi Ling went on their last tomb-raiding mission but when Wu Xie receives a mysterious text from his missing uncle, he calls upon the other two to investigate.

title: Affinity
description: In 2051, bioengineering student Wu Nongyu and sociopath Xie Xinxu are drawn together by a mysterious genetic attraction. As their relationship grows, they must confront their pasts and navigate love, trust, and redemption while racing to find a way to break the powerful bond that threatens to control their lives.

title: Rebirth
description: During the Battle at the Frozen Lake, both Zhuge Yue and Chu Qiao fell into the icy waters. Chu Qiao was rescued by Yan Xun, only to learn that Zhuge Yue had perished; she subsequently sought an opportunity to assassinate Yan Xun to avenge Zhuge Yue. While in Bian Tang, Chu Qiao received repeated assistance from a mysterious man, someone who felt strangely familiar, leading her to suspect that Zhuge Yue might still be alive. Meanwhile, Yan Xun's actions grew increasingly extreme, plunging the four kingdoms into chaos. Ultimately, will Chu Qiao be able to restore peace to the realm, guide Yan Xun back from his misguided path, and reuniting with Zhuge Yue, help secure a better homeland for the people?

title: C/O Sir
description: Jayabrata Ray, a teacher of a reputed school in Kurseong, finds himself in a helpless situation after losing his eyesight. Although the school authorities allow him to continue with his job for a while, but all hell breaks loose when he starts getting threat calls from the management asking him to vacate his property that is situated right inside the school premises. Jayabrata, who had also been a student of the same school, could see through their real intention and simply refuses to budge.

title: World War C
description: It's war. War against an invisible enemy that is not as deadly as we are told. The world is changing rapidly. Disproportionate measures are taken worldwide that disrupt society as a whole. A dichotomy in society forced vaccinations and restrictions on freedom. Have we had the worst? Or is there something more disturbing to awaiting us.

title: As Beautiful as You
description: Chronicles the ups and downs of Ji Xing as she navigates being an entrepreneur and falling in and out of love.

title: Against the Current
description: Shen Jialan, once a nobleman's granddaughter, falls from grace after her family is falsely accused of treason. Abandoned by her fiancé Lin Jinqi, she is forced to assume a servant's identity in his household. Despite hardships, she refuses to bow to fate. With resilience and wit, she rises above class barriers, wins Lin Jinqi's heart, earns the family's respect, and ultimately clears her family's name.

title: Who Stole My AC in 40°C Heat?
description: Marco, an appliance dealer who rose from the bottom, returned to his old apartment building and paid out of his own pocket to install air conditioners for every household, as a way of repaying the kindness he had received years ago. However, his neighbor Marina took the lead in filing claims under various pretexts and engaging in moral blackmail. Without arguing, Marco dismantled all the air conditioners overnight and took them away. When the scorching heat arrived, the old building suffered terribly, while the new building across the street remained cool and orderly. After enduring heatstroke, shortages, and failed extortion attempts, the neighbors finally broke down and had no choice but to turn to Marco for help. Marco presented them with a business contract and insisted that things be done according to the rules. In the end, the neighbors paid to have the units reinstalled—except for Anna, the only one who had stayed clear-headed back then, and who received Marco's free, special care.

title: Princess Silver
description: Rong Le, a princess of the royal family of the Xiqi Kingdom who wakes up one day to find that she has lost her memory. She is ordered to marry Zong Zheng Wu You, seventh prince of the neighboring Beilin Kingdom, though her husband-to-be refuses to let her inside his manor. Unable to return home, Rong Le settles down in Beilin and opens a teahouse under the alias of Manyao. It is rumored that the Qin family has misplaced an extraordinary tome that will supposedly usher in a time of prosperity for all the kingdoms, and Manyao embarks on a journey to find the book. Manyao and Wu You meet and fall in love without realizing each other's true identity, though they are forced to separate when Rong Le's brother Rong Qi orders her to marry the powerful General Fu Chou.

title: Niya vs Sin-D
description: Niya and Sin-D exchange armwork and go-behinds as the two grapple for position and advantage in this evenly matched bout. Sin-D finally escapes and ensnares Niya in a Hammerlock, but soon finds herself trapped in a grinding Side Headlock. Sin-D takes the momentum with an eye rake, then tosses Niya into the turnbuckles and delivers numerous shoulder blocks to Niya’s back in the corner. Niya battles back with a knee to the gut, followed by a Headbutt, but Sin-D stops her in her tracks with a Chinbreaker. The two struggle for supremacy on the mat, where one wrestler locks on a bodyscissors, then adds a Sleeperhold to put her foe out cold on the canvas for a hard-fought victory.

title: Atash-e penhan
description: It invokes the memory of the 16 September 1982 massacre at the Sabra and Shatila refugee camp in West Beirut. In the early 1980s at a poolside gathering in southern Lebanon Jacob, a Jew of Lebanese extraction, is killed along with a number of his associates by a group of Israelis dressed as Palestinian combatants. Jacob's sister and his daughter Sara survive the attack. The Palestinian combatants realize the goal of the Israelis is to incite public opinion against their struggle so they expose the ones who are really behind the attack. After taking part in an unsuccessful terrorist operation against Abu Khalil and his son Abu Ali, Sara realizes her Israeli fiance designed and executed the plot to kill her father. Israeli soldiers retaliate and arrest a group of Palestinian leaders, including Abu Khalil. After this incident two Palestinian combatants wipe out the Israeli Command Staff in a suicide operation.

title: I Remember When I Die
description: If the human concept of time ceases at the moment of death, is it then physically possible to experience eternity? Can we affect this last moment in life? Can we build our own eternity? 'I Remember When I Die' takes partly place at life's last destination, a hospice - and is partly shot in a land of memories and provocative choices. We meet the patients, their stand-ins and their dreams. Death is a process. Not black and white. If you could hold on to a memory forever, which one would it be? A highly original journey into the mystery of consciousness.

title: Sa-rang-i i-gin-da
description: No pain, no gain. This is the motto of the Yoo family: the father is a successful doctor, the mother supervises their daughter's scholastic performance from the vantage point of their beautiful home. Then cracks appear in the facade which soon deepen and spread. In particular, the father seems to be losing control - he is suddenly faced with a sexual harassment lawsuit and an absurd running battle with a taxi driver.

title: I fichissimi
description: Mechanic Romeo and grocery deliverer Felice lead two rival gangs and the local discotheque is not big enough for the both of them. When Romeo falls for Felice's sister, conveniently called Giulietta, the entire town becomes too small for the two rivals. Romeo is adamant to keep on seeing Giulietta while keeping clear of Felice, while Felice is forcing other suitors onto his sister that are more to his liking.

title: And I Ride and I Ride
description: Musician and Kat Onoma band leader until 2004, Rodolphe Berger lives as if he had nine lives. He's had many determining if paradoxical meetings, with artists or fameless and workless characters, to the point of sabotaging himself sometimes. He kept on going no matter what, transfiguring rock music, mixing his own intimate story with some history of music, a story of people with a story of places. He kept going towards a destination he didn't necessarily want to know about. We only know where his home bases are: Sainte-Marie-aux-Mines, Paris, Batz Island. We only know that it all stems from something - that his personal path took him from philosophy to music.

title: 9/11: I Was There
description: Intimate portrayal of the events captured by the ordinary people on September 11.

title: Welcome to the J: Inside Army Jungle School
description: As tensions with China build and the US military sends more troops to the Asia-Pacific region, soldiers with the skills to fight and survive in the jungle are increasingly vital. The US Army trains soldiers for jungle warfare at the 25th Infantry Division's Lightning Academy on the island of Oahu in Hawaii. Insider's chief video correspondent Graham Flanagan spent 12 days inside the Army's Jungle Operations Training Course, where a cross section of soldiers of various ranks and experience levels learn to fight, move, and survive in the jungle. Eighty students begin the course on day one, but only 51 will make it to graduation. The rest are dropped from the course by failing one of five critical tests. On day nine, students begin a three-day culminating exercise that incorporates the skills and lessons taught in the course, such as rope systems, rappelling, survival skills, small-unit tactics, and land navigation. Students who graduate from the course receive the Army's coveted jungle tab.

title: Channel K
description: Half-hour series comprised of shorter segments, all lampooning TV programming, all intentionally in bad taste. Included "Bachelor Pad," where love guru Chad Randolph offered tips to single dudes on how to score chicks while on a budget; "Bikini Beat," where police badges come on skimpy bathing suits; "The Handy Dan Show," where an incompetent do-it-your-self expert showed the TV audience why to never do it yourself; "Life Styles of the Poor and Unkbown," a glamorous look at the not-so-glamorous lives of the under-privileged; "Too Hip," about a pair of Simease twins joined at the hip, one neat, one sloppy, who serve as police detectives; "6 and 1/2 Minutes," an investigative news magazine uncovering stories not big enough for prime time; and "Gomer Hiel, N.A.Z.I.," following the madcap adventures of an inept soldier in the World War II German army, among others.

title: Dickie K.
description: 1980s NYC: Reagan says "Just say no," Koch asks "How am I doin'?", and a drug addict in his twenties is confronted with two choices: dying by the monkey sitting on his shoulder or accepting the help of his family and a new chance to reach his full potential.

title: Anna K
description: Anna Karenina is a socialite and wife of the soon-to-be governor of St. Petersburg, who enters a life-changing love affair with Vronsky, the dashing heir of an aluminum empire.

title: Anna K.
description: Joana suffers from a double personality and is obsessed with Anna Karenina, the character from Tolstoy's novel. Embodying the myth of Narcissus, Anna K. is the image and resemblance of Joana, stronger and more seductive.

title: K-911
description: In this sequel to the action comedy K-9, Detective Mike Dooley and his trusty canine companion Jerry Lee get two new partners - a Doberman Pincher named Zeus and his new trainer.

title: Shooting Stars
description: Oh Han Byul leads an entertainment agency's PR team. One of her top clients is star Gong Tae Sung who does no wrong. They went to the same university, where he became her sworn enemy. They bicker but soon develop feelings for one another.

title: L
description: A woman finds herself reliving a traumatic experience until a voice tells helps her work through her problems. She slowly begins to understand what must be done even if that may be something terrible, the voice commands.

title: Kwatera L
description: Depicts the fate of the families of the soldiers of the independence underground and anti-communist opposition activists who were murdered in the Rakowiecka prison in Warsaw in 1948-56.

title: L. Frank Baum's The Wonderful Wizard of Oz
description: Young Kansas farm girl Dorothy Gale is taken by a tornado to the marvelous Land of Oz. Together with her strange new friends, she will free the people of Oz from the rule of wicked witches and false wizards in her search for a way home.

title: The 40 Year Journey of Marvin L. Winans
description: The 40 Year Journey of Marvin L. Wianans catalogs the life of one of the most recognized names in the gospel industry, "Marvin L. Winans." It tells the story of one man's faith and personal struggles from the perspective of those who knew him best.

title: L'absente
description: A young woman, suffering from amnesia after an accident, might be a missing child who disappeared 11 years ago.

title: Las hermanas L.
description: Two estranged sisters have to live together after many years of a bar relationship. All their past comes back to haunt them with some funny and strange circumstances.

title: Salsal ni L
description: L, an alluring dance instructor chooses Rey, a rich businessman, over Lukas, her dance partner. But when Lukas feels something is off, he knows L is in grave danger.

title: Uang Panai' Maha(r)l
description: Anca (Ikram Noer) just returned from overseas. He was reunited with his ex-girlfriend Risna (Nur Fadillah) and intends to marry her. But Anca's intention was hindered by a marriage conditions: Uang Panai' with a fantastic amount of money.

title: Bilder (m)einer Mutter
description: A seemingly entirely normal childhood in the 80s, captured on countless video cassettes. On them a family in which each one plays their own role. But there's a shadow on everyday life. With his camera the father calmly documents how in between christmas celebrations and school events the mother becomes more and more of a shadow of herself. At first she disappears from the recordings, later on from the family all together. Father, brother and sister are left and the family construct crumbles. With her film the director callenges her family to break their decades-long silence concerning the loss of the mother. A diary is found, as well as the father's old super 8-recordings, in which the mother still smiled into the camera lovingly. We emerge into the life story of Gaby, who dreams of leaving the bavarian small town and her old school parents as a teenager. Despite the revolutionary cliché of the 70s, marriage is the only logical way to independence for the couple. The climate of the time, torn between emancipation and a conservative way of though, rubs off on the biography of the young woman. Images from society and politics show plenary chambers filled by men and planes with no female pilots in sight. Gabi struggles with the realization of her dreams while her husband lives out a successful career. The camera joins a woman on her tragic life's path, who ultimately stumbles over her role as mother, which she never fully took on.

title: Nelsons N 5
description: World-renowned conductor Andris Nelsons, music director of the Boston Symphony Orchestra, arrives in Amsterdam to conduct Shostakovich's powerful 5th Symphony before the city's renowned Royal Concertgebouw Orchestra.

title: Rock N' Roll
description: Story of a world renowned bassist Chandramauli trying to impress a singer named Daya by composing music.

title: Fish 'N Chips
description: Fish and Chips, the animated series tells the stories of two antagonistic characters, young impressionable "Fish" and his mischievous, lifelong enemy "chips" as they tear across both land and sea in these exciting adventures that are sure to have both children and adults laughing.

title: Tricks 'n' Tracks
description: The series of magic, music, tricks and tips. With Paul Zenon , Sally Gray , resident robots Arbie, Adam and Eve, and Russ Stevens performing some dazzling illusions.

title: Zone(n)050
description: In Ledeberg - "Police zone 050" - there is a group of young people that met each other at Keizerpark or Centrumplein. Some say they are drug users, dealers, or commit crimes - A one sided story. In zone(n)050 these young people get a voice to tell us their side of the story. About the problems they have had to deal with, about how difficult it can be to grow up and stay on the right path, and about their dreams. Still one sided, but just as true. Zone(n)050 is a documentary about suns, sometimes absent fathers and amazing mothers.

title: Rock 'n' Wrestling
description: Saturday-morning cartoon series featuring the stars of the World Wrestling Federation.

title: Otis N' Dwayne
description: Two androgynous creatures embark on a psychotronic journey of self-discovery in a cruel, unusual, mostly male world in this dark comedy about two gay androids abandoned in a New Jersey suburb inhabited by God, the devil, and other lowlifes.

title: Ika N Okomi
description:
A house wife with a flippant mouth finds her life and marriage turned sour in a twinkle of an eye and when the necessary solution is taken, it amount to the unspeakable deeds of her confidant's past life. Find out more.
This movie features Odunlade Adekola, Folorunsho Adeola, Olaitan Sugar, Sunny Alli, Bukola Ojo, Kitan Bukola.

title: N of 1
description: An electronic parts salesman in Toronto with no medical training conceives an idea that could revolutionize medicine. title: Salt n' Pepper
description: The story of a few foodies, whose fondness of food bonds them together.

title: Lost n' Found
description: In this new media LGBTQ sitcom, Marty and Harvey, along with the most ragtag collection of friends and family, go on a imbroglio journey to find themselves in the city of Los Angeles.

title: Partners 'n Love
description: David and Max are semi-divorced and business partners. Because of a legal technicality, they are still legally married. David sees this glitch as an opportunity to reunite with Max in wedded bliss but a corporate raider complicates things.

title: B'hike n BASE
description: This adventure is a unique experience, a journey that combines cycling and base Jump which has never been done before. Adventurer and base jumper Francky Malleus who is 27 and from France, will spend a month and a half on his bike carrying only his camping gear and base jumping equipment on his cargo rack to go jump from the cliffs of the Alps.

title: The Bits 'N Pieces Show

title: O

title: O Supermanso
description: While his wife Lucia is on vacation in Guarujá, Amaro sets up a scheme with his partner to meet other women. His partner's wife and his mother-in-law find out about the plan and tell Lucia. Angered, Lucia tries to get involved with a TV star and a good-looking young man. At the same time, a couple tries to consummate their honeymoon, and other people also seek sexual pleasure during the summer. Amaro, on the other hand, gets a date but not everything goes as expected.

title: O filos mou o Lefterakis
description: Thodorakis is a womanizer who lies to his wife about having a friend who lives in Patra in order to cover his dirty business. What happens when this fake friend appears in front of him and the night before he is ready to go with his mistress?

title: Quando o Tempo Sela o Amor
description: Um acordo desenrola a perseguição persistente de Kim Woo-jin por Lim Eun-ju. Dizem por aí que ele a ama até os ossos. Acontece que Eun-ju vivia à deriva após o término com seu antigo amor e aceitou o pedido de Woo-jin por impulso. Woo-jin abandona o sonho de ser médico e vira marido em casa, dedicando-se em segredo a desenvolver um medicamento para a alergia dela. Mas ela continua fria, só com Seo Min-ho no coração. Quando Seo Min-ho retorna, Woo-jin pede o divórcio.

title: O Quarto
description: An ordinary forty-year old man living alone in a small, drab apartment faces the imminent loss of both his job and his eyesight. An unexpected affair with a beautiful, idle and bored socialite becomes his last hope.

title: O Sol - Caminhando Contra o Vento
description: Documentary telling the story of short-lived newspaper "O Sol", an alternative press item which hit the streets during the repressive years of military dictatorship in Brazil, more precisely in 1968. Created by poet Reynaldo Jardim, it had important collaborators in Brazilian cultural scene.

title: O vasilis, o Iason kai o Doky
O loustrakos
description: A small loustrakos manages with perseverance and the help of a lawyer to acquit his mother, unjustly accused of the death of her boss .

title: Amanda O
description: Amanda O es una diva del pop admirado y blanco favorito de los paparazzi. Acusado de ser un ladrón, Amanda es asediado por los periodistas en una ceremonia de premiación. La angustiada Amanda huye y se despierta al día siguiente magullado, maltratado y en un lugar desconocido. En su viaje para recuperar su identidad, Amanda va a cambiar drásticamente y enamorarse de un salvador más inesperado.

title: O Kadin
description: The film is about the life of a fashion designer who had a tragedy in her childhood.

title: O Bobo
description: Set four years after the Portuguese revolution and the simultaneous loss of the Portuguese empire in Africa, the story concerns a director who sells guns to finance his play.

title: O Predileto
description: Based on the novel "Totônio Pacheco", written by João Alphonsus. At the time of the decadence of the great farms of Minas Gerais, Totônio is a symbol of the golden age of state farms: old and accustomed to having all his wills obeyed. However, after moving to his son's home because of his wife's death and the resulting loneliness, he realizes that he has lost his job as a boss and is struggling to regain his prestige by moving to a brothel.

title: O Rebu
description: A luxurious reception is interrupted when a body is found floating in the pool. One thing is certain: the murderer is among the high society guests

title: O Arrependimento é o Castigo
description: Karen é dona de casa e casada com Tom, um advogado rico. Enquanto trai o marido, sua casa pega fogo e a filha, Anna, de cinco anos, cai do andar de cima. A pequena é resgatada por Merry e levada por um caminhão dos bombeiros ao hospital. No caminho, o veículo colide com o carro de Karen. Sem saber que a menina ferida é sua filha, Karen exige desculpas e indenização — e atrasa a única chance de salvar Anna.

title: O Debate
description: A chief editor of a newsroom and a TV host, who were married for a long time, must try to conciliate their personal distinct views while working together during the coverage of a political debate of great importance for the nation's future.

title: O Jogo
description: Auntie Nini dies, she leaves a big fortune, but to win it they'll have to play a game she left them, the relative who wins the game will own her fortune.

title: O tsarlatanos
description: An immigrant in Germany works hard to be able to live his family in Greece. When eventually forced to return, he discovers that he hasn't a damn, because the bank has bankrupted. So returns hidden in a car-fridge and arrives frozen.

title: O grousouzis
description: A grumpy old man finds a baby on his doorstep and decides to adopt it, much to the amazement of the people in his neighborhood.

title: O Rebelde e o Estudioso
description: Maya Hayes é uma aluna nota dez com um objetivo: estudar muito, escapar do pai violento e nunca mais olhar para trás. Mas ao buscar refúgio em um estúdio de tatuagem após uma surra, ela esbarra no rebelde do Colégio Oakridge, Jude Sinclair. Logo, a aluna exemplar e o garoto rico com um passado sombrio viram colegas de classe. As madrugadas viram segredos compartilhados, e os insultos dão lugar à compreensão. Aos poucos, enxergam além de suas armaduras e descobrem algo verdadeiro. Juntos, fazem um pacto: libertar-se, lutar e destruir tudo o que tenta derrubá-los.

title: It's Showtime
description:
Kung may isang alamat na hindi nakakasawang balik-balikan, ito 'yung alamat na masarap panoorin habang sila'y kumakanta at nagsasayawan. None other than P-Pop group, ALAMAT, na nagbabalik ang grupo sa 'It's Showtime' studio para i-perform ang Luzviminda,

Walang basaan dito pero bubumuhos ang swerte at good vibes kasama ang mga taga-San Juan City (na kilala sa 'Wattah Wattah' Festival) sa 'Laro Laro Pick' game arena.

Naglaro rin sina Teddy Corpuz, Darren Espanto, Jackie Gonzaga at Ryan Bang. Si Jackie lang ang nakatawid sa 'You Gotta Lyric,' kung saan tama naman ang sagot niya, pero pabirong idineklarang "wrong" ni Jhong Hilario dahil sintunado. To the rescue naman si Darren para itama ang tono! Dackie moment na ‘to!

Samantala, na-touch ang Showtime hosts sa kuwento ng buhay ni Wo, isang delivery rider na laki sa lolo. Habang itinataguyod ang sariling pamilya, gusto rin niyang maibalik ang sakripisyo ng lolong nagpalaki sa kanya. Samantala, 'extra' ang banter nina Kim Chiu at Jhong na nauwi pa nga sa dilatan ng mga mata. At syempre, kanya-kanya silang entry ng jokes tungkol sa pangalan ni Wo!

Very good din si Tate, ang tricycle driver na sweet lover kay misis, at may malasakit din sa kapwa. Minsan na niyang pinatunayan ang kabutihan nang ibalik ang gamit na naiwan ng pasahero. Kaya ang madlang girls sa studio, na-in love kay Tate! 'Yun nga lang, si misis, umapela, "Sorry po, married na!"

Luck ay na-attract ni Margo, ang hairstylist na 'di nauubusan ng kuwento. Pati tungkol kina Ogie Alcasid at Anne Curtis, meron siyang 'chismis.' At shoutout sa mga ex niya, hanggang tingin na lang daw kayo sa kan'yang ganda! Umabot sa P35,000 ang Li-Pot offer, na tinanggap ni Margo. Tama ang pinili ate n'yo dahil nang subukan niya ang P350k Pot question, akala niya'y 'simple' lang pero hindi pala niya alam ang kasagutan.

It's time for Region 1 to shine sa second week ng ika-10 taon ng "Tawag Ng Tanghalan."

Ang unang kalahok ay mula Laoag City, si Jeanel Silvestre, na nagpamalas ng husay sa entablado, singing Juan Karlos ‘JK’ Labajo's "Demonyo." Katulad ng idol na si JK, nagsusulat din ng kanta si Jeanel, na bet 'piratahin' ni Ogie nang magustuhan ang sample ng self-composition nito. Speaking of songwriting, may tip si Ogie tungkol d'yan.

Ang awit daw ay hinuhugot sa sariling kuwento, parang si Louie Ocampo, na binuo ang "Tell Me" mula sa sariling karanasan. Binalikan din ng 'Showtime' family ang iba pang iconic songs na nilikha ng maestro. Proud din si Ogie dahil komposisyon ng kanyang kaibigan

ang napiling bagong theme song ng isang airline. Chika niya, isa siya sa napakaraming tinalo ni Sir Louie sa paggawa ng theme song na 'to.

Samantala, napabilib ni Jeanel sina hurado Jonathan Manalo, Bituin Escalante, at Maestro Louie. Para sa kanila, strength ni Jeanel ang pagiging chill nito, at ang magandang tone.

Mula Pangasinan, lumuwas si Shekinah Barbiran to chase her dream sa tanghalan. "Ikaw Ay Ako" ni Klarisse De Guzman ang napili niyang sandata sa laban ng bosesan. At 15, 'beterano' na siya sa pagsali ng contests. Dahil seasoned kontesera, nakita ng hurados ang pagiging relaxed niya.

Nagustuhan ng hurados ang dalawang nagtanghal pero isa lang ang aabante sa susunod na round, at ito ay si Jeanel na nakakuha ng markang 91% laban sa 89.3% ni Shekinah.

description:
Ihanda ang damdamin, musika niya ay damhin. Si "PBB Gen 11" ex-housemate Dylan Yturralde na ang bahala sa kiig playlist mo today. Nagkuwento rin si Dylan tungol sa kanyang music journey at paano siya na-inspire ni OPM icon Rico Blanco.

Sabi nila, respect your elders, kaya saludo tayo sa mga seniors na sa dami ng karanasan ay matatawag na certified life achievers. This Thursday sa Miss Q and A segment ng "It's Showtime," nagkasukatan ng seniority at timeless wit at beauty.

Ang ating senyoritang sosyal at elegante, rumampa sa Miss Q&A, walang iba kundi si Señora Danica Parong Evidente. Sa isang titig niya baka ikaw ay matulala, walang kupas ang karisma ni Medusa Valentina Galema. At kayo na raw ang humusga kung tao ba o hayop si candidate Exotic Tayop.

Biro ng hosts, tatawagin nating "Miss Q and A" Senior Edition ang segment for today's video dahil may twenty percent discount na ang mga 'lola' n'yo. Pero sa kulitan, full price ang tawanan. May aral din na mapupulot tungkol sa mga pangarap na hindi dapat ibaon na lang sa limot. Dahil age is just a number, pero ang 'slayable' attitude will last forever.

Sa pagtitinda ng laruan, bata ang madalas nilang pinasasaya. Pero sa araw na 'to, sila naman ang nabigyan ng ligaya sa game arena. Toy sellers mula NCR ang bumida sa Laro Laro Pick.

Si player Ria, never paglalaruan ang puso ng nobyong si Eric. At never niya itong ipagpapalit kahit kanino, kahit kay Ralph de Leon pa! Biceps at makinis na kutis ni Ralph, hindi umubra!

Dahil walang naka-survive sa mga challenges, bumunot ng lucky player na aabante sa jackpot round, mga bes. Si Liza ang pinabalik sa game arena para sa chance na maiuwi ang malaking kwarta!

title: Miss Q&A Havana
description:
Kasama natin for today's video ang bandang The Red Strings, na very inspired sa paggawa ng nakaka-good vibes na musika. Sa mga taong naghahanap ng organic encounter, at para sa lahat, ang kanta nilang "Nasa Ulap."

Matatapos na ang June, pero hindi ang wit at tawanan sa "Miss Q and A." Sina Kishan Garcia ng Makati, Rhain Bayonon ng Manila, at Havana Alawi ng Quezon City ang nagPAKsiklabn sa 'chukchakan' today.

Para kay Kishan, her tattoos are part of her charm at kagandahan. Eh, kung may bagay na tattoo kay Havana, ano kaya ito? May naisip na si Vice Ganda! Pwedeng kulayan daw ng blue si Havana tapos ‘avatar’ ang kalalabasan. 'Amats' nga ni Meme ang beki na may kakaibang 'hugis' ang tainga, at ang boses ay tunog galing ibang planeta. Biro ni Meme, parang nagtatawag ng alien si Havana.

With grace and substance ang talakan nina Kishan at Rhaine sa Wit Lang. Si Kishan, nabunot ang tanong na, "Ilang oras ang dapat itulog ng jowa mong napagod na sayo?" Sagot niya, hindi dapat makatulog sa kaiisip sa kan'ya ang ex-jowa.

Mga kwentong nakakatuwa at may hati na inspirasyon at pag-asa ang pasalubong ng mga taga-Malanday, Marikina sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Nakakuwentuhan nina Vice Ganda, Kim Chiu at Amy Perez ang isang tricycle driver, na pakiramdam ay wala ng pag-asa ang mga pangarap niya. Kaya ang payo nila, maniwala! Sabi nga ni Kim, "The world is big and so are your dreams."

Big naman ang aktingan sa inaabangan na 'You Gotta Lyric' round. Si Teddy Corpuz, tiklop sa mga lalaking malaki ang katawan. Si Jackie Gonzaga, tiklop naman sa paalala ni Ion Perez na taken na siya.

It must be the curly hair na naghatid ng swerte kay Bert, na sinugalan ang P100,000 POT money. Ano nga ba ang halamang pinakamabilis tumubo ayon sa Guinness World Records?

title: Miss Q&A Nunoy
description:
Maligayawang kaarawan, Chief of OPM Ogie Alcasid. Bukod sa "It's Showtime" family, present to celebrate ang nag-iisang reyna sa puso niya, his forever favorite ka-duet, his misis Regine Velasquez. From the heart ang mensahe ni Asia's Songbird sa chief ng kanilang tahanan.

Imbitado rin sa episode ang isa pang hitmaker, Moira dela Torre, na ginulat ang malang people sa mataas niyang energy.

Hit at bentang-benta rin ang witty talak ng tatlong kandidata sa Miss Q and A. Break muna sa pagbubbunot ng ngipin ang dentistang si Dra. Ruth Qanal, at sa chukchakan muna siya humugot ng banat. Ima-mine mo rin ang good vibe na dala ni Dyeyzel Romero, ang live seller talakera. At agaw-eksena ang intro ni Nunoy, na para bang dinala tayo sa liga ng basketball.

Triple treat din ang attendance nina Anne Curtis, Vice Ganda, at Vhong Navarro, na hindi matapos-tapos ang kulitan at bardagulan. Anne is back, and so is her 'bulol' hosting, kaya si Meme Vice ay 'nabuwisit' sa kanyang sabaw moments.

Pati ang hosts nag-enjoy sa mga tanong sa Tumpak Ganern. Ano nga ba sa Ingles ang tanikala? At ang isang bugtong, nasagot ni Anne, but as usual, in a sosyal way nga lang!

Nag-babu nang maaga si doktora, matapos maligwak sa Tumpak Ganern round. Kaya sina Dyeyzel at Nunoy ang umabante sa Wit Lang.

From palengke, napasugod sa game arena ang mga masisipag na tindero't tindera. Pasok, mga suki, swerte ay hitik sa Laro Laro Pick.

Usapang isda muna tayo kasama si nanay Dada, na nag-sample kung paano mag-alok sa mga parokyano at pumaldo nang todo. Ang isa pang sikreto, dapat kilay on fleek upang ang customers ay maakit.

Gulay na madaling itanim at anihin naman ang category sa It's Giving kung saan dalawa lang ang natira. It's Dada versus Mila. Pagdatating sa hulaan ng title ng kanta, parehong olats ang dalawa. Kaya bumunot ng iba, at ang swerte ay kay Mie napunta.

P450,000 ang pwede niyang mapanalunan. Syemmpre, gusto ni Mie 'yan! Pero mas pinili niyang maging praktikal at tanggapin ang Li-Pat offer na P50,000. 'Yun nga lang, alam pala ni Mie ang sagot sa katanungan.

title: NAHILO! Pokwang, NILARO ang comment sa Miss Q&A
description:
Kilig harana ang hatid ng bisitang si John Rex Baculfo, who shared that it feels nice to be back onstage singing his new single, na tungkol sa mga taong patuloy na umaasa. Napahugot si John Rex doon ah!

Sa tanungan at talakan, bawal ang sabaw at lutang. Dapat mabilis mag-isip at mas okay rin 'yung chukchak na may halong tapang. Tatlong reyna muli ang sumabak sa "Miss Q and " daily round sa "It's Showtime."

Maraming baon sina Lianne Marie Etorma, Jerica Arboleda Ibarra, at Reign Manzano Gaboy pagdating sa kalokohan, syempre pati na rin sa talakan. Si Lianne nga ba ang totoong panganay ni Ogie Alcasid? "Kalokalike" ang hatol ng mga nagmamasid.

Si Jerica naman, pitong taon lamang nang magsimulang sumabak sa pageants. Kahit madalas talo, bakit hindi siya nagasasawang sumali sa mga patimpalak na ganito? At matapos malotlot ni Lianne, si Ogie nagbigay ng words of wisdom.

Sa "Wit Lang" round, nabunot ni Reign ang tanong na, “Sino ang anak ng mag-asawang sampal?” Laro rin ang tanong na napili ni Jerica, “Sa iyong palagay, mabaho ba ang hininga ng kaututang dila?”

Mapapaisip ka talaga sabay matatawa katulad ng na-feel nina hurado Pokwang, River Joseph, at Nicole Cordoves. Si 'Mamang' Pokwang, nilaro rin ang comment. Nahilo raw siya sa sagot ng isang kandidata, na sa sobrang lalim parang pwede nang hukayin.

Mga taga-Dela Paz, Antipolo, Rizal ang sumabak sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Parang rollercoaster ang kuwentuhan ng hosts kay player Lizel, na naging 'judge' pa sa isang impromptu papogian portion ng male hosts. Sino nga ba ang pinakagwapo? Nanguna sa ranking si Vhong Navarro, at si Ogie Alcasid naman ang inilagay sa dulo, kaya siya ang naging target ng panunukso.

Umabante sa jackpot round si player Monique, isang volunteer tanod sa kanilang barangay. Para siguradong may maiuuwi, dedma na si Monique sa P400,000 POT question at tinanggap ang P30,000 offer na malaking tulong na raw para sa needs ng pamilya.

title: River Joseph, hurado sa Miss Q and A!
description:
Good music ang hatid ng “Tawag Ng Tanghalan” male champions na sina JM Yosures, Reiven Umali, JM Dela Cerna, Christian Tibayan, at Yannie Paul Basical. Pinagsama-sama ng limang powerhouse singers ang kanilang winning voices sa isang performance na perfect pampagaan ng mood bago sumabak sa weekend.

Nagbabalik sa "It's Showtime" for a second chance sa Miss Q&A Resbakulawan sina Nadie Marie Fernandez, Miukie, at Belle Tinkerbell.

Tumatak si Nadie dahil sa tawa niyang kakaiba. Natandaan naman ni Vice Ganda ang unique na pangalang Miukie. But arguably the most remarkable of the three, si Belle, na binansagang 'Sofronia Vasquez' ni Meme. Siya 'yung kandidata na sa pagpindot ay nahuli pero sa talak ang daming sinasabi. Hirit niya, baka pinabalik siya dahil awa, pero itinanggi 'yan ni Vice Ganda. Sabi ni Meme, nabitin daw ang lahat sa talak noon ni Belle.

Pagkatapos ng Wit Lang, ang Top 2 na sina Nadie at Belle ang nag-face off sa Beklamation kung saan mayroon silang tatlumpung segundo para sagutin ang tanong tungkol sa epekto ng pagkawala ng taong minamahal. Naging emosyonal si Nadie na inalala ang nawalang pamangkin, at galing din sa puso ang chukchak ni Belle na nagpahayag naman ng pagmamahal sa ina.

Dumayo sa Laro Laro Pick game arena ang mga taga-Barangay Batis, San Juan City. Hindi pasyal ang sadya nila kundi mga challenges na pwedeng magdala sa kanila sa POT money.

Nakipagkuwentuhan ng hosts sa tricycle driver na si Viomar. Pero ang nagpakitang-gilas, walang iba kundi si Amy Perez, na daig pa ang tricycle driver sa kanyang knowledge. Ang mga pasikot-sikot na kalye sa Maynila, kabisado ni Tyang!

Si Edwin ang nakarating sa Jackpot Round. Bago pa man ihain ang Li-Pot offer, buo na ang loob niyang ilaban ang ₱400,000 POT question anuman ang ialok sa kanya.

title: Kandidata, pinulikat sa gitna ng Miss Q&A weekly finals
description:
Limang ‘accla’ na maririkit ang nagpasiklaban ng wit sa isa na namang masayang weekly finals ng Miss Q and A sa "It's Showtime."

Bago ang talakan, enjoy muna ang mga Miss Q and A weekly finlists at ang mga hosts na sina Vhong Navarro, Vice Ganda, at Jhong Hilario sa kuwentuhan. Dahil Sabado at bihis na bihis ang mga 'fersons,' hindi maiwasan ang OOTD puksaan. Si Vice, napagtulungan dahil sa suot niyang shorts na basketball uniform daw, at boots na pampulis kalawakan. Si Jhong naman, very Gen Z at trendy sa buhok na kulot. Hirit naman ni Vice sa suot na nude vest ni Vhong, parang action star ang pormahan pero may Barbie arms.

Samantala, na-miss ni Vice Ganda ang pagkikita nila ni candidate Bong Bong, na lumaban noong August 13. Papayag nga ba si Meme na rumesbak si Bong Bong?

Idol talaga sa chukchakan sina Miss Q&A weekly finalists Jurexa Caparino, Nadimunyo Lustre, Miss Pau Ellarina Ortiz, Rocky Cueva, at CK Alcaraz Zarfl.

Si Nadimunyo ang unang naligwak sa kompetisyon, samantalang ang apat ay umabante sa Wit Lang. Mula naman sa apat, ang Top 2 na sina Rocky at CK ang nag-face off sa final round, Beklamation, kung saan pareho nilang hinarap ang tanong na, "Ano ang mas mahirap—tanggapin ang ayaw mo o tanggihan ang gusto mo?"

Mahusay sila sa time management habang pinagsasabay ang sports at academics. Pero sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, maging champion kaya ang mga student athletes?

Si player Angel-El, may pag-demo ng karate moves. Ingat lang baka matamaan ng sumisipa niyang galawan! Sumisipa rin ang good vibes sa aktingan round na You Gotta Lyric. Ito na ba 'yung DaCkie in an LQ scene? Ay, sina Ryan Bang at Teddy Corpuz pala!

Bigo ang mga natirang players na mka-survive hanggang dulo, kaya bumunot ng isang lucky manlalaro. Parang buzzer beater shot, biglang nabuhay ang kapalaran ni Jayvee. Hindi man niya nasagot ang POT question, hanga pa rin si Vice Ganda sa fighting spirit ni Jayvee at sa sipag ng mga kabataang atleta, kaya naisip niyang regaluhan ng extra P1,000 ang bawat players.

title: Chyort s portfelem
description: The journalist of the regional newspaper "Raduga" Mikhail Makarov, a fearless author of accusatory fieletons, a principled fighter against slovenliness and mismanagement, sharply criticizes the editor-in-chief, who does not let his scandalous articles go to press or cut off his scandalous articles due to lack of facts. Once buying potatoes at the market, Makarov meets a young saleswoman who offers him to collect critical material on her collective farm for the next fieleton. Having gone on an editorial trip and convinced on the spot in all the facts about the rotting record crop of potatoes, the enthusiastic journalist prepares a devastating article. title: Brasil S/A
description: Brazilian Dream is fruit of reflection on Brazil today. We Brazilians are used to seeing the country as peripheral, subaltern, poor and third-world. But in recent years Brazil has experienced rampant transformation that has reconfigured its archaic social structure. Yet this difficult and paradoxical modernization runs up against problems that seem to be historically determined. In the film we ask: what images can capture this new country? And we chance a few answers, starting with the delirious fable-spinning of a nation drunk on its own progress. These are images and sounds that echo and, at the same time, collide with the grand founding narratives of the national mindset. Through these images we enter into conflict with the messianic vocation of a Brazil eternally pre-destined to be the country of the future. Bodies, machines and landscapes move and shudder. Until the final eclipse.

title: Making Sh*t Up
description:
This film takes you behind the scenes in the timeline of a dynamic and ambitious young conceptual artist, from his "Clearance Sale" of a lifetime's work at ArtLA, to weeks of dispensing therapy at the Whitney Biennial, to a near-death injury on Miami's Biscayne Boulevard and the mindset that followed. Includes detailed on-site action at art installations and performances, with spirited opinions from celebrated artists and art world professionals about measuring the success and value of conceptual art.

The film is narrated with spirited, candid commentary by important artists and art professionals such as legendary conceptual / performance artists Marina Abramovic and Vito Acconci on the highs and lows of a conceptual art world with uniquely difficult career choices, by famed New York Magazine Senior Art Critic Jerry Saltz on what is and isn't conceptual art and how Rodriguez measures up, author Steven Henry Madoff about Rodriguez service aesthetics achievements, and celebrated New York art blogger C-Monster.net, who experienced the artist, face- to-face and alone, locked inside his therapy cube.

title: Duh u mocvari
description: A brother and sister, Miron and Melita, go to visit their friend Zoltan (Liptus) in Kopacevo for winter vacation. The local residents and hunting lodge members there are involved in a big campaign to help the wild animals from the reserve to survive the winter. The same night Miron and Melita arrive, a boy named Halasz is found half-frozen at the edge of the swamp where, he raves, that he was attacked by a white ghost on one of the islands of the swamp. From then on, he can no longer talk. The old woman Etelka reveals the secret that the ghost had been first seen long ago and that you cannot go to the island because the ghost wreaks vengeance on anyone stepping onto the island. Fear takes hold in the place. The hunters, with Vucevic, Kovacevic and Levay taking the lead, begin an investigation however neither they nor the doctors can help Halasz. Therefore Miron, Liptus and Melita decide to find the ghost and offer to carry it off the island to the shore in exchange making their friend well again. However, the ghost shoots and wounds the hunter Levay proving that the ghost is much more dangerous than was previously thought.

title: Dr. W
description: Now you are in the domains of magic and fantasy! You are surrounded by the wonders of life and you can ask as many questions as you want! You're on the Dr. W Show! Are you afraid? Are you tired? Alone? Bored??? Have you lost your faith??? Dr. W is here and has something for everyone; No matter if you are small as a microbe or as big as the universe, fast as lightning or slow as evolution, you will get something amazing! Really surprising! So try not to get too excited, try not to laugh and shout very loudly, because what you are about to see is something that you have not seen before. Welcome ... this is the Dr. W Show! Dr. Woody Bonepecker, aka Dr. W, is a delirious doctor who is always looking for the truth of the natural facts of everyday life. He is the presenter of a TV program, and in each episode he will explain to the audience different phenomena in his particular, ironic and hilarious style. Dr. W is really stubborn, he is not afraid of anything and will do anything necessary to get to the bottom of things. In his show, Dr. W uses all kinds of resources to present and explain the topics. Not only does he perform crazy experiments as a good scientist, he also appeals to the most absurd humor as if he were a clown, or to the most fantastic magic as if he were a magician. Dr. W also has the help of special guests in many episodes, as well as an enormous variety of characters that appear to help him in the development of each theme. Likewise, the live audience has a fundamental role, as it reacts to the explanations of Dr. W at all times.

title: W Wish [English]
description: Juuna Tono is a boy without a past. Orphaned by a tragic accident that claimed the lives of his parents and his memory, Juuna and his younger twin sister Senna have only survived by their commitment to support each other. But when a strange girl greets him as "Big Brother" (onii-chan) Juuna turns to her and says, "Haru...hi?" It is someone from his forgotten past, who Senna claims is his childhood friend - or is she?

title: Twarza w twarz
description: Face can be altered the same as the identity. However, past remains unchanged. Sometimes you try to get away from it but sooner or later you will have to face what happened in order to rebuild your life. Victor 'Dragonfly' is a highly skilled thief. He is shot in face during a police action in which a policeman dies. Dragonfly becomes prime suspect. Because of being chased by the police Victor escapes abroad. Thanks to his friend, Baker, he lands in Swiss plastic surgery clinic run by professor Michalski. His daughter Martha, a talented plastic surgeon, undertakes Dragonfly's face surgery. During two years she conducts series of operations to change Victor's face. Martha is not aware of her patient's past and she falls in love with him reciprocally. Dragonfly wants to start a new, honest life with beloved woman. However, their plans are ruined by Victor's past. He returns to Poland in order to clear himself of a charge of murder. Martha is familiarized with the criminal past of the man she loves. She starts doubting in his innocence...

title: Lato w Byszewach
description: Film adaptation of a short story by Jaroslaw Iwaszkiewicz. The action of the film takes place, among others, in the manor house in Byszewy near Lodz, to which the writer first came in June 1911.

title: W domu
description: Spring 2020, Poland. 16 filmmakers create 14 short films about unexpected experience of isolation caused by pandemic.

title: Aard W Talab
description: "The series follows intersecting lives under pressure, led by Heba, a schoolteacher who struggles to support her family, care for her brother with disabilities, and save her sick mother."

title: W pustyni i w puszczy
description: Fourteen year old Polish boy Stas Tarkowski and eight year old Nel Rawlison from England are kidnapped as the hostages by Arabic fanatics and taken to their religion leader. Then they manage to escape and try to return to their fathers. Children have a lot of dangerous adventures, meet two Black kids; Kali and Mea, who also help them, make a friendship with an elephant and help one Black's tribe. Finally they manage to return. Based on great novel, the same title by Nobel receiver (for all his literary output) Henryk Sienkiewicz.

description: It follows two brothers-in-law, Mardi and Dahham, and the many problems that take place between Mardiya and her husband Dahham, while Mardi attempts to reconcile them.

title: We are alright
description: After quitting their corporate jobs, Bartek and Rafal decided to create their first video game. The movie follows them throughout the last few months of working on the project. You'll be able to witness their struggle to publish the game on PlayStation, the emotions of people associated with the game's launch, and finally, Rafal's and Bartek's attempts to break into the consciousness of youtube stars and the industry press.

title: Abnaa w Qatalah
description: When Shaikhon marries Dalal, a belly dancer. He steals Dalal's money to buy the club where she works. Dalal gets back at him and reports him to the police who have him imprisoned. He comes out of prison full of vengeance.

title: "FALSE REAP" w/ Joseph Watson
description: Joseph Watson, formerly known as Baby Joe instructs how he enters into leg attacks using what is known as the "false reap". A very tricky and unforeseen entry when an opponent is using a knee slice or combat base. Always on the mend of evolving techniques, Joe is an incredible athlete and an even better teacher.

title: Vares X
description: Vares gets a desperate call from his friend Kyy, who needs saving. While Vares is saving his friend, the daughter of a new family of private detectives is kidnapped. Vares has to gamble with higher stakes than ever before. Events begin to link up with the parties of a mysterious sex cult and a showdown in the underworld. Who can Jussi Vares finally save?

title: The X Files
description: Two F.B.I. Agents, Fox Mulder the believer and Dana Scully the skeptic, investigate the strange and unexplained, while hidden forces work to impede their efforts.

title: X² - Double X
description: A series of music videos to promote the anime 'X'.

title: Tu y yo
description: A country musician man and a high-class architect woman fall in love.

title: Serrat y Sabina: el símbolo y el cuate
Rojo y miel
description: tells the story of Claudia Bernard and Rodrigo Carvajal she was a young university student used to life in Santiago and Rodrigo is the foreman of the farm that belonged to her mother.

title: Vida y color
description: Teenaged Fede is trying to overcome his family's peculiarities--a sister's unsatisfied wedding; a grandfather's refusal to talk to his best friend; a family friend coping with Down's Syndrome, and then there are the bullies.

title: Samy y yo
description: Samy Goldstein, a writer for a television program, is surrounded by an oppressive female environment. Then decides to resume his passion for literature. Meet Mary, a beauty in crisis. From there a series of misunderstandings will happen.

title: Y++
description: A series of sketches about the miseries of life in the 21st century and its effects on the human condition.

title: Cocolos y Rockeros
description: This documentary examines the musical tastes of Puerto Rico's youth. The terms "cocolos" refers to those who prefer "salsa" music, and "rockeros" to those who prefer "rock" music. Through interviews and an array of musical settings the film explores the young people's feelings in a humorist yet serious manner, bringing to the forefront issues of biases and national identity inherent in this innocent yet very powerful form of social entertainment. Includes musical performances by Gilberto Santa Rosa, El Gran Combo, REO Speedwagon and others.

title: Carne y arena
description: Based on true accounts, the superficial lines between subject and bystander are blurred and bound together, allowing individuals to walk in a vast space and thoroughly live a fragment of the refugees' personal journeys.

title: Luces y Sueños
description: 1986, Jorge is 7 years old and his parents take him to the cinema for the first time, Jorge is fascinated by the first movie he sees and his passion for cinema is born.

title: Fulano y Mengano
description: The stay in the prison of Eudosio and Carlos, accused unjustly, prevents them from getting a job when they go free. As much as they intend to explain that they were locked up for no reason, nobody will listen to them. So they decide to steal to stay alive. His house is a whole building in ruins, without any closed window and with the walls that are barely standing. Esperanza will try to turn that space into a home, where she works with enthusiasm. But life is very hard and coexistence is also difficult.

title: Y que patatín, y que patatán
description: Five episodes that reflect a critical look on the universe of children. An ironic metaphor about the training of children and how they respond to limiting situations in their lives.

title: Oscuro y Lucientes
description: Goya's body remained forgotten in a pantheon in Bordeaux. Decades later, everyone present at the exhumation was greatly surprised: Goya's skull was missing.

title: Contigo pan y cebolla
description: The purchase of a fridge (a huge investment then) is a pretext to show the joys and hardships of a traditional Cuban family in the 50s. Extremely funny.

title: Pobol y Cwm
description: A Welsh-language TV soap (the longest running BBC television soap) set in the small Welsh town of Cwmderi, in the heart of the South Wales valleys.

title: 70 Y Pico
description: Grandpa, why did they try to kill you? The documentary addresses the animic changes that the filmmaker experiences while he tries to understand the participation that his grandfather played, as a civil associate, during the last military dictatorship in Argentina. The role that he played as the Dean of the Architecture Faculty at the University of Buenos Aires, as a link with the concentration camp ESMA, is one of the multiple topics that grandpa "Pico" narrates in camera.

title: Perros y Diablos
description: A bank robbery goes wrong, and Cobra is the only one who served time for it. 10 years later, those involved reunite to celebrate his release from prison, but things have changed, and the new gathering of friends turns out to be different.

title: Nacional y Popular
description: The life's story and militancy of the members of the Cooperative of stream's cleaning New Hope and Progress, formed by young and (and not such much) militants of the Movimiento Evita in Malvinas Argentinas , a Gran Buenos Aires town The work in the river, the activities in the district and discussion panels is the starting point, so that the companions can analyze the Conjunture of their political process and the roll that militancy and working class play today. From 2001's Crisis, to the triumph of Cristina Kirchner in the national elections, happening through the Town or Corporations discussion Resolution 125 generated, the negative mass media vision of the citizen protest, to the Nestor Kirchner's funeral the documentary recalls the Won and Lost Battle s this last eight years and the way to consolidate a nation for all.

title: Locos y Sueltos
description: In the city of Miami Beach came the idea of surprising tourists and messing with the locals routine through uncommon and funny tactics. By showing them spicy situations in which visitors to this sunny city become the stars. "Locos y Sueltos" is born. The show is hosted by Santamonica, whose debut has captivated us all with her refreshing beauty.

title: Amor y Mentira
description: Andrea, una universitaria, quedó embarazada de Mario, quien fingió ser pobre por una apuesta. Al ser "condenado a muerte" (él era en realidad el Señor de la Guerra), Andrea se hizo cantante para salvarlo. Al descubrir la verdad, usó una máscara; Mario, sin reconocerla, la humilló. Demasiado tarde, entendió su error.

title: Codicia y Traición
description: Elena estaba de ocho meses de embarazo. Como logró la gratificación de fin de año de cinco millones por haber obtenido un gran pedido para la empresa, su jefe la recompensó con una baja de maternidad por anticipado. Elena quiso dar una sorpresa a su marido y su suegra, dijo en broma que estaba despedida, no esperaba que la actitud de los dos cambiara drásticamente y la abofeteó de inmediato. Ella no pudo soportarlo, juró a la familia de su marido que pagaría el precio.

title: Rem - Z
description: Felix Gruber a New York City boxer trapped and captured by a masked clown and his companion Laura. Felix finds himself in a situation where the only way to get out is to obey the Clown's request. The Comicbook styled silent movie thriller.

title: Z Dead End
description: July 4th 2015 the world was invaded by zombies. Humanity was put to the test in a small town in Colorado, where it all began.

title: Kava z Kardamonom
description: Lviv, at the dawn of the nineteenth century. Young Anna is living a simple life, helping her uncle in the bakery, while her brother is in the seminary. Yet, Anna dreams of something much grander: true, mutual love. Her family has a different idea for her. She is supposed to marry the wealthy tradesman Marykan - and while he is in love with her, she cannot muster the same feelings for him. Then everything changes, when Count Adam Rodzinsky arrives to visit his sick uncle Witold. First, Anna is afraid of the older Adam. But then, she develops feelings for him, especially when they start to cross paths more and more frequently. Turns out, Adam was once married to a distant relative of Anna's, but the relationship ended in tragedy. Anna reminds him of his former beloved. Yet as their love blossoms, it remains forbidden.

title: Project Z
description: At once a road-trip, detective story and zombie flick, Project Z tracks - behind the scenes and headlines - some of the most challenging global security issues of our times.

title: Blackout Z
description: When a transatlantic flight goes missing, Federal Agent Tallulah Murphy is assigned by the President to investigate and stop the threat before it's too late.

title: Malzenstwo z rozsadku
description: Joanna's parents run a clothes shop. Big, hidden income does not allow them to sleep peacefully and they want their daughter to marry poor artist-painter, because only such profession allows to justify income without suspicions.

title: Z Storm
description: This is a story about the biggest financial fraud attempted in Hong Kong, directed at the Government of Hong Kong and involved all 7 million Hong Kong citizens... no one is free from the scheme. Within the four decades of guarding Hong Kong's financial integrity, the ICAC has never come across an opponent so huge and so well organized as in the Z Torrent file... shadowy figures from the underworld of South America, Italy and Europe all ready to plot against the estimated 150 million dollars of Hong Kong citizens' tax money which was pooled in a fund called the WELFARE FUND. High profile chartered accountants, high ranking law enforcers, power lawyers, the super entrepreneurs; they all have their shares of play but none can really grasp the big picture; they are there only for what they desire most. When the wife of an up-rising star Superintendent of police force reported his corruption simply out of bitterness for being ill-treated, little did she know she is about to pull the head string from a very well weaved web of deceive, greed, sex, power, and last but not least, fear. The ICAC agent LOK who took charge of the simple complaint felt otherwise... it's his passion for justice that has been driving him all these years in the battle against bribery and corruption, even after losing his beloved wife. Further investigation soon revealed many unanswered questions and loose ends...the death of an ex-godfather status accountant of Hong Kong, the threats to even the seemingly harmless witnesses and informers, and the surfacing of a mysterious lady that has all connection with LOK's wanted list but with a background as simple and as tragic as a girl next door with terminal illness... As Lok dug deeper into the web, he is being hunted by trained foreign mercenaries; a tactic very seldom or never heard of in the history of Hong Kong's underworld! With the support of his superior the old but streetwise Deputy Chief of ICAC, Lok eventually unlocked the door to the plan, but only after a bloodbath gun battle that almost cost him his life and that of the attractive mysterious woman, Angel.

title: Pojdi z mano
description: In search of the best photo for the school competition, four teenagers head to remote hills. The competition for awards turns into a struggle for survival. Manc, who leads the group to remote but scenic countryside, where he spent his childhood with his grandpa, had been accused of stealing a phone and consequently might be expelled from school. Schoolmates Mina, Oto and Spurc join him on this trip. Mina, who is spoiled, stubborn city girl, breaks first in this foreign environment, but luckily by her side always stands Oto, rational boy who is in love with her. In this untouched nature which is such an unknown world to them also Spurc, who was golden-spoon-fed all his life, turns into a cowardish spoiled-child, and at the end Manc is again the one who safely guides them back home. A story about growing up, love, friendship and heroism. The warm but suspenseful and occasionally spine-chilling film focuses on what happens in the today's world when technology stops working and the 'primal' human instincts come to light.

title: Gen Z
description: Gen Z is a series which portrays how the younger generation deals with life's struggles while striving to achieve their ambitions and its impact on their relationships with family and friends.

title: Power of 1
description: Izu Ojukwu's Power of 1 is now available on Amazon Prime Video for viewers in the US and UK. The political thriller, which is partly inspired by 2 Baba's shelved 2017 protests stars Alexx Ekubo in the lead role of Justin Aba, a socially conscious afro-pop artiste with a large following. When Justin Aba decides to use his influence to stage a protest against the policies of the incumbent government, he is drawn into a game of politics he didn't bargain for. This film shows the twists, turns, and intrigue of a proposed protest march called by an influential pop artiste, that shook the socio-political landscape of Nigeria to its very foundation. Nerves are stretched to breaking point as the decision to take ownership and execute the protest throws up intriguing reactions from security operatives, political players, hustlers and opportunists Power of 1 stars Ramsey Nouah, Anne Idibia, Jide Kosoko and Michelle Dede. The film was released in cinemas nationwide last December and has played in theatres in the UK and US.

title: 4 Idiots
description: King, Queen, Jack, and Ace-four misfits surviving through petty crimes in Chennai-found their world turned upside down when COVID-19 lockdowns shut down public transport, their main source of income. Desperate for a way out, King discovered an audio recording about a bungalow filled with black money, supposedly guarded by a lone watchman. Seeing it as their golden opportunity, the gang set out to execute the perfect heist. However, upon entering the bungalow, the door slammed shut behind them, and a chilling voice welcomed them. The so-called security guard was none other than Pulibaba, a notorious gangster. With a gun in hand, he forced them to surrender their belongings and made a sinister phone call: "Doctor, the delivery is ready... Eight kidneys." Their dream of a quick fortune has turned into a nightmare of survival. Now, they have only one choice: outsmart Pulibaba or become the next victims of his dark business. A twisted game of greed, betrayal, and survival is about to unfold.
